title: Two-tier eval gate separation
prose: Deterministic Tier-1 structural evals require direct explicit plugin scope and run only the selected plugin; -FullRepository is a direct operator route. Tier-2 LLM evals require direct Invoke-WazaEvals.ps1 -Plugin invocation and must never enter configured build/test or deterministic scripts. Scope is validated before provisioning or output.
description: Keeps local deterministic validation focused, offline, and zero-cost while preserving a separate explicit plugin-only premium Waza route.
